title: Passage to Chult
epigraph: From the House of Healing to the jungle's edge — by oath, by storm, by ice, by augury.

title: Down the Soshenstar to the Failing Camps
epigraph: From the cooled town to a sail set for a silent city — by canoe, by lasso, by spared goblin's oath, by creeper-fire, by the amulet off a dead queen's neck, by the guardian left half-woken in the moss, by the guide's parting and the Flaming Fist's coin.
